primary_sources.supports: Recent reauthentication for adding/removing passkeys; protected account mappings and server revocation
Separate authentication/authorization; server-side operation binding, execution gate, limited lifetime and unique operation authorization
Challenge/origin/RP/user verification/signature verification; application must define business-operation binding

priority.conclusion: Address reproduced bearer-only sensitive-write gap before expanding delegation
priority.type: Project inference from baseline, bounded reuse and primary security controls

checks.name: Strict operation schema
checks.evidence: Tagged enum, deny_unknown_fields, strict variants/field types; no client-supplied approval state

checks.name: Purpose separation
checks.evidence: Mixed management/invocation rejected; finish compares presence and exact operation; valid management emits no session or mutation

checks.name: Session and account binding
checks.evidence: Start requires valid bearer session with matching account name; finish rechecks exact token and account before approval

checks.name: Role at approval and mutation
checks.evidence: Owner role checked at management start/finish and grant mutation; ordinary guests cannot approve owner writes

checks.name: Verified active signing key
checks.evidence: Existing library verifies assertion; user_verified is required; current matching active key/counter reloaded and transactionally updated

checks.name: Exact mutation binding
checks.evidence: Every mutation requires account/session/operation equality and active approving key; raw label, recipient, TTL, target and kind cannot be substituted

checks.name: All four sensitive write gates
checks.evidence: credential_start, credential_revoke, create_grant and revoke_grant require server-owned approval; bearer-only tests assert403 and unchanged state

checks.name: Failed attempts and replay
checks.evidence: Approval removed before parsed handler validations; malformed JSON is not a parsed consumption attempt; same ID cannot be retried after success or mismatch

checks.name: Monotonic lifetime and cap
checks.evidence: Instant expiry60s pruned and checked at consumption; cap128 checked at management start and finish; unit test sets expired Instant without runtime clock backdoor

checks.name: Parallel replay and write serialization
checks.evidence: One Inner mutex spans approval removal/check/write; unit and browser parallel duplicate cases commit once

checks.name: Enrollment continuation
checks.evidence: Add consumes approval at start and stores its actual signing key; finish rechecks same session/user and active approver, including approver distinct from original session key

checks.name: Credential revocation and migration
checks.evidence: Transaction protects last key; commit then clears all account sessions, auth/enrollment/approvals;8-key limits, global uniqueness, legacy alias and tombstones retained

checks.name: Restart invalidation
checks.evidence: Memory-only approval map starts empty; actual restart test rejects pre-restart approval even after valid fresh session login

checks.name: UI confirmation and parameter snapshot
checks.evidence: Concrete action/target displayed before assertion; stored sessionName used; local operation snapshots inputs once; inFlight serializes actions

checks.name: Actual assertion abort and retry
checks.evidence: Disable virtual presence, begin real navigator assertion, cancel via WebAuthnAbortService;0 finish/0 write/unchanged grants; retry succeeds using same session

checks.name: Token storage, rendering and network surface
checks.evidence: Session/approval values remain closure/process memory; no persistent browser storage or token logging; target text uses textContent, application requests use existing local API paths

checks.name: Dependency and compiled access point
checks.evidence: Existing package/verifier pins retained, no new runtime dependency; generated bundle retains full SimpleWebAuthn MIT notice

oracle.binding: Exact final source SHA256s match root freeze and were rechecked after integrated build; current reports read independently

limits: Local synthetic CTAP2 only; no hardware, biometrics, platform sync, recovery or production-deployment claim
Server-side operation binding does not establish trusted hardware display of business parameters
Existing wall-clock session and ceremony behavior is outside the new monotonic approval lifetime
No cryptographic primitives or new dependencies introduced by review lane
invalidation_rule: Final signoff applies only to recorded hashes; relevant later source changes require affected-path re-review and oracle rerun

nonblocking_scan.disposition: Large API/E2E files and existing bounded health polling catch reviewed; no confirmed defect and no warning-only refactor
